@aio:claude-modules: `compose.yml` runs the infra (Postgres, plus Redis if that module is enabled) — the app
itself runs on the host (`npm run dev:api`), not in the compose stack, so `tsx watch` keeps
working normally. `docker compose up -d` before the first `npm run migrate`. `Dockerfile`
builds a standalone production image of `apps/backend` (build context = repo root).
